legislative_basis: EStG (§4 Abs.5, §6 Abs.2, §7, §10, §32a, §35, §37, §§38-42f, §39b); SolZG; KiStG (Länder); UStG (§12, §18, §19); GewStG (§2, §7, §8, §9, §11, §14a, §16, §19); AO (§149, §233a, §240); SGB IV (general), SGB V (health), SGB VI (pension), SGB XI (care); KSVG; BMF Programmablaufplan (PAP) 2025, September 2025 revision; BMF letter of 26.02.2021 (one-year useful life for computer hardware and software)
_conventions: Every figure is extracted from the source_guides above with the authority citation the guide states. Rates are decimals (0.19 = 19%). The German tax year is the calendar year. Income tax uses the formula-based §32a EStG tariff (linear-progressive zones), NOT simple bracket multiplication: zone boundaries are given with the exact BMF PAP formula per zone. Amounts are EUR; monthly/annual is stated per entry.
_source_conflicts: Where two source guides state different 2025 values, this file follows the figures de-payroll.md attributes to the BMF Programmablaufplan 2025 (September 2025 revision, §32a EStG constants): Grundfreibetrag 12,096 and SolZ Freigrenze 19,950/39,900. The conflicting figures in de-income-tax.md (Grundfreibetrag 12,084; zone edges 17,005/66,760; SolZ exemption 18,130/36,260) and de-estimated-tax.md (SolZ 18,130 with Milderungszone to 33,761) are omitted from this file. germany-payroll.md contains 2026 PAP values (Grundfreibetrag 12,348; KV/PV-BBG 5,812.50; Minijob 603) and is not used for this 2025 file.

tariff_zones.source: §32a EStG, 2025 PAP constants, BMF Programmablaufplan September 2025 revision (de-payroll §3, UPTAB25)
tariff_zones._note: Formula-based tariff: within zones 1 and 2 each euro is taxed at its own marginal rate; do not compute with simple bracket multiplication. X = taxable income in whole EUR. Splitting (Steuerklasse III / Zusammenveranlagung) applies the tariff via KZTAB = 2.
